name: Truther
description: A truther seeks (or claims to know) the truth about some fringe subject. In the Third Imperium the most universal truthers seek knowledge of the Ancients or paranormal phenomena.

truther.name: Truther
truther.description: Seek the truth, whatever it may be.

mishaps.1: Injured in a misadventure or attacked by a deranged objector to your work. Roll on the Injury table and leave this career.
mishaps.2: Someone affected by the Truth you seek bears a grudge and swears to kill you. Gain an Enemy.
mishaps.3: You are discredited, rightly or wrongly. Lose SOC -2 and FOL -D3, but you are not ejected from this career.
mishaps.4: You discover that some of your work is based on erroneous thinking. Lose 1 skill level from any Science skill but you do not have to leave this career.
mishaps.5: Your Truth is misused or misrepresented and you get the blame. Lose all Benefit rolls gained thus far in this career, but you do not have to leave this career.
mishaps.6: Your Truthing alienates former colleagues and contacts. Gain D3 Rivals.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: A corporate or government body wants to use your knowledge in a way you find questionable. If you agree, gain an extra Benefit roll and one level in any Science skill, but also D3 Enemies.
events.4: You are called upon as a consultant for a secret research project. Gain one Contact and DM+1 on one Benefit roll.
events.5: Understanding some new revelation requires a crash course in a field you lacked knowledge of. Gain one level in any Electronics or Science skill you previously did not already possess.
events.6: Your search for Truth takes you out onto the frontiers. Gain one level of Survival or Recon.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: You make a series of high-profile appearances on entertainment or news shows. Gain one level of Carouse or Persuade, and gain FOL +1.
events.9: A golden opportunity lands in your lap, but taking advantage of it will harm someone else's career. Exploit it (FOL +D3 OR SOC +1 OR two levels in Science/Medic/Electronics, plus D3 Enemies) or decline (gain an Ally).
events.10: You come into contact with a mysterious group interested in your Truth. Gain one level of Streetwise, Recon or Carouse, and gain D3 Contacts.
events.11: A very public disagreement goes in your favour. Gain SOC +1 but also a Rival.
events.12: Your work becomes mainstream after a scientific breakthrough. Gain FOL +D3.
